method: Direct HTTPS retrieval with desktop User-Agent during implementation; initial default-user-agent Red Cross and CDC requests returned 403.

sources.observed: Food list distinguishes three days for evacuation from two weeks for home.
Recommends at least several days of nonperishable food and accounting for family dietary needs.

interpretation: The existing draft three-day food criterion is a limited product planning horizon. It is not completion of the longer Red Cross home recommendation. No per-package or per-person food-day conversion follows from these pages.
